notes: Eligibility period: the 5 years immediately before the date you sign (apply). IRCC's FAQ example: applying on 1 April 2018 uses 1 April 2013 to 31 March 2018.

Each day in Canada as a permanent resident counts as 1 day; each day as a temporary resident or protected person before becoming a permanent resident counts as 0.5, up to 365 days of credit (730 calendar days).
Protected person time counts only from approval of the claim or PRRA until 1 day before becoming a permanent resident.
Does not include time in prison, on parole, on probation, or waiting for a decision on a refugee claim.
Day of departure and day of return count as days in Canada (IRCC physical presence calculator FAQ, A3).
Time outside Canada as a Crown servant or family member of one counts as days in Canada.
